key_line.metric: Q4 adjusted EBITDA guide and 2027 EBITDA outlook
key_line.detail: Q4 adjusted EBITDA guided to approximately $715m, about in line with or marginally below the ~$725m Q4 implied by the hunt's 2H26 consensus (~$1.3bn, parameter.io). 2027 adjusted EBITDA expected to exceed $4bn on new contracts and price forecasts, against ~$2.3bn consensus and Wells Fargo's above-consensus $2.65bn (parameter.io), and above management's own ~$3.3bn July framing (IndustryWeek). Stelco a positive EBITDA contributor in Q3; galvanizing lines idled, hot-rolled tonnage kept; idled-facility charges $4m in Q3; major debt reduction expected in Q4.

guidance.detail: Q4 numeric guide ~$715m (in line with street ~$725m implied); 2027 >$4bn EBITDA is far above the ~$2.3bn street figure and above the ~$3.3bn management framed in July.

call.detail: Call started 08:30 ET and is underway at 09:00; no report of its content found yet. It ends before or near the open, so it is not a risk held into the session; the Stelco/Ottawa Q&A is the part that could still move the price before 09:30.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst action, wire story or retail thread on the Q3 2026 print found by 09:05 ET; searches return only older quarters and the 2026-10-06 Wells Fargo upgrade ($12 to $14), which predates the release. With the stock already near $14 pre-market, target raises are likely to follow during the session, but none is observed.

tape_read.note: Pre-market 13.832 at 08:57 ET (+14.1% vs 12.12), high 13.98; above the 10.55% option-implied move but inside this name's recent guide-driven reactions (+16.0%, +21.5%, +12.5%). Q4 is only in line, so the gap is carried by the 2027 >$4bn figure, a step change the street has not modelled; a credibility discount on that number is the main reason not to call it an undershoot. Extended-hours volume reads 0 (source does not report it). Market mildly up (SPY +0.47%).

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a Q3 beat on HRC spot and a firmer forward guide on contract resets. Q3 beat its own guide by $37m; the Q4 guide is in line rather than above (the one part that missed the panel's expectation); the 2027 outlook confirms the contract-reset thesis far more strongly than the panel assumed.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de these: Q3 boven de eigen prognose en vooral een 2027-vooruitzicht van meer dan $4 mrd EBITDA, bijna het dubbele van wat analisten rekenen. Dat getal moet nog door koersdoelen en modellen heen, bij bmo-namen loopt de herwaardering doorgaans door tot het slot, en met 13,9% van de vrije float short komt er koopdruk van dekkers bij. Daarom aanhouden tot het slot in plaats van om 13:00 uit te stappen; het risico is dat de markt het 2027-getal niet gelooft en de winst intraday deels teruggeeft.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de pre-market koers voor 09:30 duidelijk terugzakt (bijvoorbeeld onder ongeveer 13,20, waarmee een groot deel van de winst weg is) of de call het 2027-getal afzwakt of een Stelco-rechtszaak of -last noemt, dan uitstappen bij de opening.
